references.title: PERFECT — clothed skeleton in real environment
references.notes: Single full-frame skeleton in a kid bedroom wearing gray tee, navy shorts, backpack, sneakers. Bones visible through glass shell. Exactly two hands. No diptych.

references.title: OK — bare skeleton in cinematic room
references.notes: Single continuous frame, neon blue glow, concrete room, one skeleton host, expressive eyes only in skull sockets (never ribcage eyes), no split layout.

references.title: MODERATE — wardrobe edit (doctor/scientist)
references.notes: Skeleton dressed as scientist/doctor via image edit: lab coat, glasses, clipboard. Real bedroom/study environment. Wardrobe layered on glass shell.

style_bible: MrSkeleWelly shorts use ONE continuous full-frame 9:16 shot with exactly one skeleton host.
Identity is always the canonical ivory skeleton inside a thin clear glass body shell — never human skin or flesh.
Wardrobe and props are image-edits ON the same skeleton: doctor coat, college kid outfit, backpack, lab gear — any style works.
Environments are real cinematic rooms (bedroom, study, concrete space) — not flat studio backdrops unless the beat demands it.
Lighting: moody cinematic mix — blue/cyan rim light, soft amber bone illumination along the spine only (never eyes or orbs in the chest), practical lamps when indoors.
Eyes: large realistic eyeballs in both sockets with iris and pupil — never hollow sockets.
Hands: exactly two hands, five fingers each — never duplicate, floating, or mirrored limbs.
Never split-screen, diptych, side-by-side panels, or before/after comparison layouts — they duplicate hands.
No readable text, watermarks, labels, or diagram callouts in the frame.
Glass shell hugs the body silhouette — no bell jar, capsule, dome, or display case.
visual_wins: Single full-frame skeleton in a real environment passes review (IOZIRg_aJkA perfect reference).
Wardrobe edit on canonical master works for any role: college kid, doctor, scientist (ex0RCKEOpbA).
Bare skeleton with cinematic room lighting passes when composition stays single-frame (sMfXKfnbACo).
Preserve exact channel look on regenerate — fix only limb/layout artifacts.
Use xAI/Seedream image edit from canonical master reference, not T2I drift.
visual_watchouts: Never split-screen or diptych — duplicates skeleton and creates extra hands.
Never edit-from a broken diptych still — delete and regenerate from canonical master.
Never side-by-side comparison panels or left/right contrast layouts.
Never third hand, floating hand, duplicate wrist, or mirrored limb.
Never replace skeleton with a human body when adding clothing.
Never flat teal studio backdrop when the beat needs a real room.
Never hollow eye sockets or missing eyeballs on the skull.
Never bell jar, capsule, dome, or glass container around the skeleton.
wardrobe_edit_rules: Start from the canonical naked skeleton master reference.
Apply complete coherent garments over the glass shell: shirt, pants, shoes, accessories as requested.
Exposed cuffs and hems must still show glass-and-bone anatomy — no human skin at edges.
Doctor, college kid, athlete, or any persona is a wardrobe delta only — identity stays fixed.
Bulk wardrobe edits across scenes use the same master reference chain.
